descriptions.text: Enchanted hat item. The Assassin's Veil. This is a unique item. Warning: This item may only be worn by a female. Warning: This item may only be worn by a feline-class species. Worn by those in the court of the goddess Sekhmet, this beaded headdress warns off strangers who might think to do harm to the bearer. Wearing this item imbues the following benefits: Plus 10% to dexterity. The Precognition Benefit. Warns wearer if someone nearby is preparing an offensive or binding spell or readying a skill. Warning: Enemies of Sekhmet will be automatically hostile to you if you wear this in their presence.

recap.text: The mailbox gives Donut a new hat, and one each for Mongo and Rend. Her Assassin's Veil replaces the tiara with a red, yellow and orange beaded headdress that clacks as she shakes her head at a little mirror, though it covers none of her face. She wants its magic drained into her tiara, but Mordecai warns the conditions would transfer too, with Sekhmet surely under Odette's thumb, and asks to research first.

beats.headline: A veil that covers nothing
beats.text: The mailbox has given Donut another hat, and one each for Mongo and Rend. Hers appears on her head in place of her tiara: an Egyptian-style beaded headdress, red, yellow and orange beads cascading down either side of her face to match her fur, the beads clacking as she shakes her head at a little mirror. It calls itself a veil, though it does not cover her face. She means to drain its magic into her tiara. Mordecai warns that the conditions would transfer too, and that Sekhmet is surely under Odette's thumb by now, so Odette's enemies would all be hostile to her. Let him research it first.
beats.gist: Donut's mailbox gives her a beaded headdress, and Mordecai asks to research it first.

relations.note: Donut's own headdress from the same class, examined in the same chapter
